classification_policy: Each record states source-reported, numerical-only or authored status.
prohibitions: Unit-cell count is not replicate count
Video frames are not independent experiments
SD does not establish sample n or confidence level
No fixed repeat count inferred from plotted markers

controls.name: Source-off baseline and recovery
controls.review_requirement: Preserve pre-on, on, post-off records as distinct phases; return of an image coordinate is not safety release.

controls.name: Pattern-flip sign reversal
controls.review_requirement: Reorientation is a new mounting epoch; link pre/post specimen identity and sign mapping.

controls.name: Array uniformity screening
controls.review_requirement: Preserve rejected element IDs and failed screening attempts; no inferred tolerance.

controls.name: Torsion-axis isolation
controls.review_requirement: Geometric argument is not comprehensive experimental parasitic-force elimination.

controls.name: Source trajectory paired with pendulum response
controls.review_requirement: Keep source degrees and response centimetres on separate calibrated channels.

controls.name: Angle-dependent sign change
controls.review_requirement: Keep the whole planned angle series and failed attempts; no selective inclusion around the transition.

controls.name: Analytical prism versus finite elements
controls.review_requirement: Not a measured calibration or fabricated control.

controls.name: Coiled topology comparison
controls.review_requirement: No experimental coiled specimen or yield inferred.

controls.name: Pre/post calibration and drift checks
controls.review_requirement: Needs qualified thresholds and review plan; not stated as performed by paper authors.

controls.name: Blind identity and completeness accounting
controls.review_requirement: Retain every admitted attempt, exclusions and custody return.
